results.name: ModProjectile Class Reference - tModLoader
results.snippet: Allows you to determine whether this projectile can hit the given NPC. Return true to allow hitting the target, return false to block this projectile from hitting the target, and return null to use the vanilla code for whether the target can be hit. Returns null by default. Can be called on the local client or server, depending on who owns the projectile . Parameters
